purpose: Prevent optional privileged credentials from becoming prerequisites for observation, diagnosis, validation, review routing, or other read-only control-plane work.

allowed_only_after: native lower-authority carrier proven insufficient for that mutation

anti_pattern: Do not set a job-global GH_TOKEN to an optional administrative secret when ordinary GET operations can use github.token. An empty optional secret must never shadow the native read token.
origin: Root cause isolated from qikvrt_autonomous_ruleset_effect_loop run 34721166944: job-global GH_TOKEN was rebound to an empty QIKVRT_RULESET_ADMIN_TOKEN, causing the first ordinary GET to fail before any ruleset mutation was attempted.
